record.offering: Utilities app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Turn conversations into clear summaries, searchable transcripts and next steps with Fieldy, your AI note taker.

A useful conversation should leave you with more than a long transcript. Fieldy helps you find the decisions, remember the details and follow through on what you agreed, from team meetings and client conversations to interviews and everyday plans.

Capture conversations with Fieldy's desktop app or a Fieldy wearable (sold separately), then review your notes on iPhone. Recording directly on iPhone is not yet available.

START WITH THE SUMMARY
Get the key points without rereading every word. Generate a summary of a conversation and choose a format that fits the discussion, whether you need meeting minutes, a client recap or a concise overview.
- Review important topics and decisions.
- Keep the summary alongside the original transcript.
- Return to the details whenever you need more context.

TURN TALK INTO ACTION
Keep follow-up tasks connected to the conversation they came from. Review deadlines, check what needs doing and mark tasks complete as you go. Before your next meeting, look back at the commitments instead of piecing them together from memory.

FIND WHAT WAS SAID
Browse and search your saved conversations. Open a transcript to revisit the discussion, with speaker labels to help you follow who said what. Use the summary for the overview and the transcript when the details matter.

ASK YOUR NOTES
Ask questions about a conversation in Fieldy instead of scanning the whole transcript. Find a decision, revisit a requirement or check the next step.
- What did we agree about the launch?
- Which requirements did the client mention?
- What do I need to follow up on?
AI-generated answers and transcripts can contain mistakes. Check important details before relying on them.

SHARE THE CONTEXT
Once you've generated a summary, send a conversation link so a colleague can read the summary and transcript in a browser. They don't need the app to read it. Anyone with the link can open that conversation, so share it thoughtfully.

Use Make Private to turn the link off again. Sharing one conversation does not give the recipient access to the rest of your account.

TAKE YOUR NOTES FURTHER
Copy a transcript or export a file for your documents, project notes and follow-up emails. Keep useful details in the workflow you already use, without retyping the discussion.

Connect Fieldy to ChatGPT, Claude or another compatible AI assistant to work with your conversations there. Draft a follow-up, prepare for your next meeting or turn a discussion into a document. You choose which tools to connect.

FOR THE CONVERSATIONS THAT MATTER
- Team meetings: revisit decisions and check follow-up tasks.
- Client conversations: find requirements before preparing your next response.
- Interviews: review a speaker's words rather than relying on memory.
- Everyday plans: return to details and commitments you want to remember.

YOUR CONVERSATIONS, YOUR CONTROL
Manage conversations and sharing from the app. Fieldy does not sell your personal information or use it to train general-purpose AI models. Its AI service providers are not permitted to use your data to train their models.

GET STARTED
Sign in with the same Fieldy account you use for desktop or wearable capture to review your conversations on iPhone. Open a conversation, generate its summary and explore the transcript, tasks and sharing tools.

Some features require a subscription. Available plans, features and limits are shown in the app. Always obtain any required consent before recording a conversation.

Privacy Policy: https://www.fieldy.ai/policy/privacy-policy

ideaShell is an AI-powered voice notes and AI assistant app that helps you quickly capture inspiration with your voice, organize your thoughts, and turn notes into action with AI agents. Whether you need voice-to-text transcription, meeting notes, a journal, reading reflections, class notes, or a place to capture fleeting ideas, ideaShell is your intelligent pocket memo and thinking companion.

【AI Voice-to-Text · Recording Notes Has Never Been Easier】
Record as naturally as you speak—AI automatically transcribes your voice into clearly structured notes. Available in dozens of languages with custom vocabulary for technical terms. AI removes filler words, optimizes formatting, and generates titles, summaries, and tags, giving you a polished note instantly. From meeting notes and class notes to reading reflections and spontaneous ideas, voice-to-text makes capturing anything effortless.

【Fast Capture · Save Every Idea from Anywhere】
Great ideas disappear in an instant. Capture them fast with Apple Watch, Siri, iPhone Action Button, Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets, Control Center, and Shortcuts. Type or draw by hand too. Import audio files, PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, or clip web content—all turned into organized notes with one tap. ideaShell is the voice recorder and notepad in your pocket.

【Enhanced Recording · More Than Transcription】
Mark key moments while recording. Add notes, take photos, import images or files during a recording. Once finished, one-tap AI note completion enriches your annotations with context from the recording. Ideal for meetings, classes, interviews, and more.

【AI Agent Assistant · Helps You Think and Get Things Done】
A powerful built-in AI agent that understands your notes. Select any note or folder for in-depth AI conversations, brainstorming, analysis, and online research. AI can also create, edit, find notes, manage to-dos, and plan your schedule. Switch between multiple AI models and use built-in guides and Playbooks.

【Content Generation · Create in Multiple Formats with One Tap】
AI generates PowerPoint, Word, Excel, web pages, mind maps, Markdown, and images from your notes. Work reports, proposals, email drafts, video scripts, to-do lists—create intelligently without starting from scratch.

【Publish and Share】
Publish notes, mind maps, web pages with a shareable link in one tap. Recipients can view and ask questions about the content. Export as PDF, Word, Markdown, images, or sync to Notion.

【Memory and Personal Knowledge Base · Understands You Better Over Time】
AI remembers key information from conversations including personal and contact details. All notes become your personal knowledge base—AI connects, searches, and answers across all your notes. Daily reviews and note recaps keep past recordings, journals, memos, and reflections delivering value.

【Connect Your Workflow】
Connect with Notion, access from messaging apps, and use MCP to let other AI products read and write your note data—seamlessly integrating into your productivity workflow.

【More Features】
Available on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac, with real-time syncing across devices. Organize content with folders and automatic tags, extract text from images, and record audio offline—all in one place for journals, memos, notes, voice recordings, to-dos, reading notes, and more.

Capture inspiration with your voice, accelerate your thinking with AI, and never let another idea slip away.
